newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela invites bidders for Fesilven.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela invites bidders for Fesilven.

text.p: The Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) said Friday it was inviting those interested in buying a controlling stake in state ferro-silica producer Fesilven to begin registering from Nov 28.

Those interested in bidding must be able to meet requirements including a minimum net worth of $25 million and a ferro-silica production capacity of more than 30,000 metric tonnes per year, the FIV said in a release.
U.S. investment bank Salomon Brothers is coordinating the sale which will set aside between 10 and 20 percent of the company's stock for workers.
Founded in 1973 Fesilven has three ovens that produce 80,000 metric tonnes of Ferro-silica per year. In 1995 it produced about three percent of the world's ferro-silica, the FIV said.
The FIV did not say when Fesilven would be auctioned but government officials have said they hope to sell the company in the first half of 1997.
